text.name: Global Financial Crisis
text.rules: Record "credit crunch". Until the end of this turn, points spent by both sides count 1 less, never below 1. SAE spends 1 point.
text.history: Lehman Brothers filed for bankruptcy on 15 September 2008, the largest in US history, and the first G20 leaders' summit met in Washington in November 2008 to coordinate the response.
